title: Bulgaria's Budget Crisis and Corruption Protests Test the Promise of Eurozone… · 03 Sep
keywords: Bulgaria, budget crisis, eurozone, euro adoption, austerity, anti-corruption protests, fiscal deficit, inflation, governance, EU integration, political instability, social-security contributions, European Commission, Sofia, public trust
notes: Bulgaria faces a compounding political emergency as a contested 2026 budget, with higher taxes and a 5.7 percent deficit, has collided with deep public distrust rooted in corruption concerns. The convergence of fiscal strain and governance instability is forcing a question the European Union cannot ignore: can euro adoption stabilize a country before its institutions have earned citizens' trust? The stakes extend well beyond Sofia.
